status.shortComment: Samac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.
status.longComment: Samac missed consecutive practices to end Week 3 with a knee injury. The backup to Blake Brandel will now miss Sunday's contest due to the injury, leaving the Vikings with less depth on the offensive line.
